camel_example: aliyun sgw DescribeExpressSyncs --region cn-hangzhou --BucketName sgw0000 --BucketPrefix test0000
description_en: Queries the details of express synchronization groups, including their names, IDs, and bucket names
description_zh: 查询极速同步组，包括极速同步组名称、极速同步组ID、Bucket名称等详情
kebab_example: aliyun sgw describe-express-syncs --bucket-name sgw0000 --bucket-prefix test0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeExpressSyncs

parameters.help_en: The name of the bucket. If you do not specify this parameter, all express synchronization groups that belong to the current user are queried
parameters.help_zh: Bucket 名称。未传递参数时，默认查询该用户下的所有极速同步组
parameters.name: bucket_name

parameters.help_en:
The subdirectory of the bucket. If you do not specify this parameter, the express synchronization groups of the bucket are queried. If you specify an empty string, the express synchronization groups in the root directory of the bucket are queried by default.

You cannot leave the bucket name empty and query only the bucket subdirectory
parameters.help_zh:
Bucket 子目录。未传递参数时，查询该Bucket的极速同步组；传入空字符串时，默认查询该Bucket根目录的极速同步组。
不支持Bucket名称为空，只查询Bucket子目录的场景
parameters.name: bucket_prefix

Code.description_en: The status code. A status code of 200 indicates that the request is successful
Code.description_zh: 状态码。状态码为200表示请求成功

ExpressSync.description_en: The information about the express synchronization groups

Description.description_en: The description of the express synchronization group

ExpressSyncId.description_en: The ID of the express synchronization group

MnsTopic.description_en: The name of the message topic in Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) that corresponds to the synchronization group
MnsTopic.description_zh: 该同步组在阿里云轻量消息队列（原 MNS）中对应的消息主题（Topic）名称

Name.description_en: The name of the express synchronization group

Message.description_en: The description of the request result

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求结果。可能值：
true：是。
false：否
